caption: The drawing is done in shades of grey, suggesting pencil or graphite on a light-colored, possibly off-white background. It depicts a carved wooden figure mounted vertically on a cylindrical base. The figure appears humanoid, standing upright with feet together, arms held close to its body, and hands resting in front. It features a long, conical hat or headdress, an elongated face with distinct features including a straight nose, lips, and visible eyes. The torso and legs are relatively slim and elongated, with simple, linear representations of clothing folds or decorations on the front. The cylindrical base below the figure is shaded to suggest a three-dimensional form. The entire composition is contained within a rectangular border, and there is a scale below the figure indicating measurements, as well as a handwritten note that reads "Barnett Wotman Doll.”
title: Whirligig
